This market refers to the doubles tennis match between Arribage/Olivetti and Cabral/Tracy in the Shanghai Rolex Masters, originally scheduled for October 16, 2026 at 10:00PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Arribage/Olivetti' if the team of Arribage/Olivetti advances against Cabral/Tracy.

This market will resolve to 'Cabral/Tracy' if the team of Cabral/Tracy advances against Arribage/Olivetti.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by October 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the team who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (a team withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

raw_market.question: Set Handicap: Hidalgo/Kestelboim (-1.5) vs Roncadelli/Zarate (+1.5)
raw_market.description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Hidalgo/Kestelboim and Roncadelli/Zarate in the Santa Cruz 2, originally scheduled for October 15, 2026 at 7:30PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Hidalgo/Kestelboim" if Hidalgo/Kestelboim wins by 2 or more sets than Roncadelli/Zarate, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Roncadelli/Zarate."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Hidalgo/Kestelboim can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Roncadelli/Zarate."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by October 29, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger results.
